notes.title: Version 3.8.0 Update
notes.notes:
Update Time: September 24th (Wednesday) 10:00 AM

Update Method: Service downtime for a mandatory update, expected to last 2 hours



Soul Draw

· Renowned seafarers, a meeting of nations!

· Heroic souls from the vast river of time gradually awaken, tempered by time and endowed with boundless divine power.

· A new Captain's Soul system has been added: awaken your Captain's Soul, granting numerous attribute and skill enhancements, while also increasing various Soul Points!

· Souls can be drawn through Soul Draw and Soul Draw.

· Various Soul Card Pools will be released regularly and irregularly in the game, so stay tuned.

Sword Control

· Soul Draw offers endless possibilities!

· A new Soul Power system and related gameplay: Martial Soul, Soul Control, and Soul Slash. Each Soul Point grants a new ability to the navigator!

· Soul Control: Grants a Soul Shield to the ship. While the Soul Shield lasts, the ship gains additional global damage reduction and immunity to most Soul Power damage (combined with other damage reductions).

· Soul Severing: Grants the ship a Soul Severing effect, breaking the enemy's Soul Shield. If the enemy has no Soul Shield or loses it, it deals additional Soul Severing damage equal to a percentage of the total damage (combined with all other damage bonuses).

· Martial Soul: Each attack deals Soul Severing damage based on the total damage. The higher the Martial Soul value, the higher the Soul Severing damage, and it is not affected by damage reduction other than Soul Shield.

· Soul Values ​​can be acquired through Souls.

Wandering Sea

· Break through the void and transcend reality!

· Added the ultra-difficult Wandering Sea challenge!

· Extremely difficult! Extremely difficult! Extremely difficult!

· The Wandering Sea is divided into: Normal Challenge - Reality Rift and Purgatory Challenge - Shicha Sea!

· Do not attempt this lightly!

Decapitation Exercise

· Capture the thief and the king, and break the rules!

Added the \[Decapitation Drill] feature to the Ming Dynasty's Southern Sea Great Wall.

You can directly challenge the level boss through the \[Decapitation Drill].

Monster Beasts of the Mountains and Seas

The mountains and seas are full of spirits, featuring the Ten Forms of He Luo!

Added the \[Ten Forms of He Luo] challenge to Monster Beasts of the Mountains and Seas.

Added Ten Forms of Monster Fragments to the Ming Dynasty's Southern Sea, along with the new He Luo Monster Skills: \[Qiaoshui Soul Domain] and \[Ten Souls Symbiosis].

Burning Embers Together

Added the Captain Combination \[Lu Xun] and \[Cheng Pu], who can form the \[Burning Embers Together] combination.

Ship Skins

Ship skins have multiple skin slots available, allowing you to equip multiple skins, with stacking effects.

Sea Shadow Shuttle

·Added Level 1 Royal VIP

·Added a limited-edition Royal VIP Captain Skin - Sea Shadow Shuttle

·Sea Shadow Shuttle features cool movement effects

·Sea Shadow Shuttle features cool combat effects

·Sea Shadow Shuttle features combat skills

General Optimizations

·Fixed an issue where Qionghai bosses would be hidden when "Hide Ship" was selected

·Optimized the "Sea Great Wall" battle, causing some players to occasionally get stuck

·Fixed an issue with the "Flying Bear Taoist" set's effects being incorrectly affected

Other Optimizations

notes.title: 3.6.0 Update Content
notes.notes:
Update time: 10:00 am, April 24 (Thursday)
Update method: Server suspension, estimated 2 hours

Power of resonance

The fleet has added a [Ship Resonance] system, which is enabled after building a tier 5 ship.

Go straight to Huanglong
·The Ming Dynasty is in turmoil, and the dragon flag suppresses the sea!

Added a high-difficulty continuous battle challenge [Go straight to Huanglong], one thousand kills are heroes, and three thousand kills are heroes among heroes!

The Ming Dynasty South has added a new Go straight to Huanglong event, and you can get a lot of echo dust and ship materials by participating!

Wuwei of the Ming Dynasty
·Catch Kun for bones, kill immortals for paddles, humane Wuwei, longevity and prosperity!
·Da Ming Nan opens the construction of the 16th-level ship [Xianzhou·Xuankun]!
·Da Ming Nan opens multiple [Ranking] functions
·Added the ability to specify the level of orders when refreshing orders at the Oriental Exchange
Monsters of the mountains and seas
·The mountains and seas have spirits, and Xuanwu guards the mountains!
·New challenge of [Mountain Guarding Black Tortoise] for Mountain and Sea Beasts
·New Black Tortoise fragments for Daming South, and new Black Tortoise Beast Skill - Layered Mountains

Command the Supreme
·Now after the captain is upgraded to [Supreme] quality, he can obtain more captain combination attributes

·New battle legends [Beowulf] and [Peleus], ​​they can form the captain combination "Legendary Man"
·New trade legends [Gilgamesh] and [Hammurabi], they can form the captain combination "King's Talent"
·New trade legends [Midas] and [Jason], they can form the captain combination "Golden Dependents"

Illusion Challenge
·The shrouded fog has dissipated again, and a new round of illusion challenges is about to begin, and the challenge of breaking through the limit is coming again!
·Powerful navigators will show what true power is here, or be crushed into powder!
·New illusions bring new challenges and rewards, go grab them!

Comprehensive optimization
·The "Quick Treasure Hunt" function has been added to the Misty Island
·Ship can now unload a whole set of suits at one time
·Added [Echo Dust] to daily task rewards
·The full-level character skin will no longer be displayed in the gift package and starfish exchange to avoid mistaken purchase

notes.title: 3.4.2 Update content
V3.4.0 update content
notes.notes:
Update time: 10 a.m. on September 25 (Wednesday) (it is estimated that the service will need to be stopped for 2 hours)


The Legend of Qionghai
·We have fished in the Caribbean, and we have lived in the Indian Ocean; we have made friends in the empire, and we have dominated Malacca;
·Now, we just want to set sail and return to that mysterious ancient eastern country - and Qionghai will be the last obstacle we face!
·Since ancient times, this place has been a land of barren mountains and harsh rivers, a dangerous place of war, and the separation of forces has led to blocked navigation. However, the mysterious spiritual beasts from the east also herald huge opportunities.
·New large map - Qionghai is officially launched. Brave and fearless navigators, clear all obstacles in front of you!

The angry sea roars
·The Qionghai Sea is home to world-famous pirates. They not only block the waterway, but also build huge sea lairs to protect the endless treasures they plundered. Their fame has even spread throughout the West.
·On ​​the angry sea, the boats and oars were wiped out with a wave of their hands, clearing the waterway, breaking through the nests, and pocketing countless treasures.
·Can you become such a legend?

The spirit comes from the east
·Mysterious spiritual beasts from the East appear in Qionghai. After being tamed, they can be carried into fleets and provide powerful assistance to navigators.
·Combat Ship Spirits can go into battle with ships and exert unique special effects to clear obstacles for navigation!
·Supporting ship spirits can provide a large number of attributes to ships, greatly improving the fleet strength of navigators!

Below Luzon City
·Order is born in chaos, and Luzon City came into being.
·The forces here are intertwined. Not only are there highly profitable exotic goods, but there are also various treasures for sale. Even the mysterious ship spirit can be traced.

Trial cycle
·The trial called reincarnation awaits the challenges of heroes.
·Various tests and rewards are waiting for you to win!

Road to navigation
·Added multiple navigation chapters and luxurious rewards, and the navigator level has reached [S level (1 star)]

Active tasks
·Added daily and weekly tasks and rewards related to Qionghai

Other adjustments
·New trade captains [Cao Chong] and [Shen Wansan] are added. They can form a captain combination of "Wealth, Wisdom and Glory"
·New trade captains [Aladdin] and [Pandora] are added, and they can form the captain combination "Fantasy Light"
·Skill [Cabin Expansion] can now be upgraded to level 50

notes.title: V3.3.0 update content
notes.notes:
Update time: 10 am on August 22 (Thursday)

sea ​​journey
·The Navigator Association was born, recruiting all adventurous navigators who are not afraid of dangers to join.
·The association has tailored various development and development goals for navigators, guiding them to adapt to maritime adventures faster, and providing massive rewards.
·The navigator level will be accumulated and improved with the experience of navigators, and luxurious rewards will be given.
·The association has opened a special discount area [Navigator Mall] in [Haixing Mall] for navigators to purchase, with as low as 10-20% off!
·Old navigators will start directly as E3 level navigators and receive corresponding level rewards directly.
·Follow the guidance of the association and start a new maritime journey!

Task Guidance
·[Daily Tasks] has been upgraded to a new [Active Task].
·[Active missions] include two types: "Daily" and "Weekly", and new missions and rewards will be unlocked with the level of the navigator and the progress of ocean exploration.
·Rewards are more generous and completion is easier!

marauding pirates
·Pirates are plundering and occupying cities. Now European cities need to defeat the defending pirates before they can enter.
·After defeating the defending pirates, you can receive development rewards in the city.
·The old navigator city is open by default, and you can directly receive development rewards without defeating pirates.

Optimization and adjustment
·Navigators whose trade level was less than level 30 before the update will start their sailing journey again.
·[Dungeon] will automatically instantly kill enemies whose combat power is far lower than yours to save the navigator's time.
·[European Ranking Tournament] The cooling time between each challenge has been greatly reduced to save navigators’ time.
·[Combat] will display the portrait of the main captain of the currently attacking ship to improve the combat experience.
·The Caribbean/Indian Ocean boss has ushered in its 13th-15th incarnation, and the challenge has been upgraded!
·The new issue of [Fantasy Challenge] is ready to go

notes.title: V3.2.2 update content
notes.notes:
Update time: May 15th 10:00

The pinnacle of shipbuilding
·Gathering the spirits of Kyushu and being born to control the nebula - the 15th-level ship [Kyushu Nebula] is open for construction, embark on the road to the top, and reach the top!
·The Kyushu Nebula has 1 basic form and 2 advanced forms. It’s up to you to decide whether it’s the toughest or the strongest!
·There has been a huge innovation in European shipbuilding technology. Building the same European ship (levels 3-8) will gain proficiency and subsequently reduce the amount of materials. The era of great shipbuilding is coming!
heart and wish
·Heaven moves in good health, and a gentleman strives to constantly strive for self-improvement!
·The navigators fearlessly explored, persisted in unyielding spirit and faith, and gathered into seven fountains of wishes containing powerful power.
·By accumulating wish stones, you can exchange for powerful power through the wishing fountain, which is the blessing from the voyagers' precious faith like gold.

Collecting craze
·The magical [Collections] from the East Indies set off a new craze in Europe. Magical painters produced exquisite [Collection Illustrations] so that navigators could easily appreciate and collect various collections.
· Craftsmen with unique skills have found the technique to recast [collections], and it will become easier to create super powerful collections.
·The weight of some collections has been adjusted.

Great changes in the oceans
·As navigators continued to explore, they finally found a direct route from Europe to the East Indies.
·Leaving the East Indies will lead directly to Europe.
·The misty island in the Indian Ocean has become more complicated and confusing. When encountering "other players", they will be randomly selected from all players.
·Caribbean and Indian Ocean bosses usher in their 11th and 12th incarnations, and the challenges are upgraded!
·The number of mirror sea challenge layers has been increased, and a new mirror sea limited challenge skin has been added.
·With the improvement of navigation technology, any material put into the Caribbean ship material synthesis now supports batch synthesis.
·With the improvement of navigation technology, navigators can automatically attack pirates on private maps in the Indian Ocean and East Indies through [Search for Enemies].
·With the improvement of navigation technology, navigators can conduct automatic attacks when participating in BOSS battles in the Caribbean, Indian Ocean, and East Indies.
·Time and fingers are liberated!

Captain new
·New battle captains [Lucifer] and [Michael] are added. They can form the captain combination "One Thought of Gods and Demons", and the gods descend to earth to cleanse the earth!

Optimization and adjustment
·Comprehensively optimized the art materials and interface UI of each interface of the game to bring navigators a better art experience.
·Optimized multiple system interface display and operation issues.
·Optimized the synthesis of European cargo cards and supported batch synthesis of recipe cards.
·Optimized the European and ocean trade experience, allowing the exchange to quickly navigate ocean and European trade.
·Optimized the storage limit of [Trade License] for some VIP levels.
·Optimized the dungeon sweep function, you can complete the sweep directly without entering the dungeon!
·Optimized the shipbuilding experience. When you lack shipbuilding experience, you can quickly use experience cards.
·Optimized the European dungeon unlocking guide.
·Optimized the novice task process and experience.
·The new issue of [Fantasy Challenge] is ready to go.
·After killing all 10 imperial invasion pirates, an additional [enemy] will appear for other members to complete daily tasks.
·The number of layers of Endless Route has been increased, and 2 new Endless Route limited skins have been added (navigators who have cleared 30,000 nautical miles will receive a reissue of 30,000 nautical miles limited skins)
·Adjusted the opening level of [Illusion Challenge]
·Adjusted the opening level of [Empire]
·Fixed the problem of abnormal effects of some suits
·Fixed the issue that the splash damage of Europa Spirit-Spirit was abnormal.

notes.title: V3.1.0 update content on January 18th
notes.notes:
European event optimization
·European events are super-evolved and a private boss is coming!
·[High Seas BOSS Battle] is upgraded to [High Seas Boss], which can be opened freely wherever you want!
·[Hot-selling products] have been upgraded to [Underground Market], full of business opportunities and warehouses full of gold bars!
·The rewards are more generous and the gameplay is easier!

Tactics Card Change
·After continuous drills, the fleet has become more skillful in using tactics!
·The number of core tactics assembled has been increased to 3! (Core tactics of the same type cannot be installed at the same time)
·When placing auxiliary tactics, you are no longer restricted by the type of core tactics!
·When saving the lineup, you can also save the tactical card configuration!
·When viewing other players' ship information, you can view their tactical card configuration.
·The most important point: When competing for the city master in the Indian Ocean, Malacca and other distant oceans, you can configure tactical cards!
·After this update, the navigator’s original tactical card configuration will be cleared. Navigators, please remember to reconfigure it!

Captain
·New battle captains [Tesla] and [Edison] have been added, and they can form the captain combination "Light of Technology".
·A large number of old captains have gained new talents and become more powerful!
·The old captains who have activated their talents are as follows: [Columbus], [Zheng Chenggong], [Da Gama], [Zheng He], [Magellan], [Samuel Baker], [John Hawkins], [John Carter] Bert], [Davy Jones], [Del Cano], [Hugh Clapperton], [Zheng Zhilong].
·The upper limit of various [Attribute Training Cards] that each captain can use has been increased.

Vessels
·Shipbuilding technology innovation, now to build ships of level 12 and above, you can choose 2 low-level material ships, no longer limited!
·Shipbuilding efficiency has been greatly improved!
·For example: to build a Tier 12 Sea Sovereign, you can choose 2 Tier 11 Saint Raphaels or 2 Princes of Will, or one of each. Both can be built.

Monthly Card
·The rewards for each monthly card have been greatly enhanced, making it more cost-effective to purchase a monthly card!
·After the update, the daily rewards of purchased monthly cards will automatically increase!

Navigation Pension Benefit
·Starting from this year, sailing has added a new sailing pension benefit, which will be paid every year!
·During the Spring Festival, distribution and collection channels will be opened.
·During the event, all voyagers can receive a large pension benefit for free!
·The level will be improved based on the time the navigator enters the game. The longer you play, the higher the pension benefits will be!

VIP
·Added 5 new royal VIP levels.
·The excess VIP points accumulated previously will be automatically converted into the corresponding VIP level. Players who have reached the level please don’t forget to claim the corresponding grand prize.

Goods
·Added ‘replenishment’ function, which can immediately replenish the quantity of goods.

Caribbean
·The [Skip Combat] function has been added to the ladder match to improve efficiency and save time.
·The [Skip Combat] function has been added to the group stage of the Contest to improve efficiency and save time.
·When synthesizing ship materials, batch synthesis of three different level 9 ship materials is supported to improve efficiency and save time.

East Indies
·Reduced and smoothed the pirate combat power of Malacca cities and treasure hunting spots.
·Reduced and smoothed the pirate combat power in most layers of [Mirror Sea Challenge].
·[Mirror Sea Challenge] The number of layers has been increased to 5,000.
·Add 3 new powerful skins limited to Mirror Sea. You can give them as gifts when you reach the corresponding level. Get the honor that belongs to the strong!
·All ships of the Malacca Overlord of the Archipelago (player) will now receive an additional durability bonus.
·Now that the Malacca Overlord of the Islands (player) is the overlord, the damage reward from the overlord activity will automatically unlock to level 9 rewards!

Others
·Protagonist skin interface, adding some prompt effects
·Suit deified interface and function optimization
·Optimization of event gift package interface
·Increased storage limit for Indian Ocean Horn

Empire
·New sea area added to the empire’s expedition port-[Evil Spirit Bay]
·The [Construction Period Reward], [Daily Commemorative Coins], etc. of the wonders of the Empire require member loyalty to reach 15 to obtain them.
·The activation level of the empire function has been increased

notes.title: 《航海霸業 MARITIME HEGEMONY》V3.0.0 update
notes.notes:
Update time: September 21, 9:30

New information-East Indies
·A piece of news that shocked the world came: the mysterious East Indies has been discovered! It will surely set off a new journey of discovery among navigators!
·It is rumored that spices and silver are everywhere in the archipelago, expensive and rare goods are worth more than gold, and ancient collections contain magical powers. The navigators who get them will benefit endlessly!

New map
·Through the Indian Ocean, you can go to the new map - East Indies.
·There are precious and rare goods in the archipelago city, and the price exceeds gold!
·Gathering the aura of Kyushu and harnessing the nebula, the 15th-level warship Kyushu Nebula was born!
·In the archipelago, [Epic] captain can be promoted to [Mythic] captain.
·In the archipelago, you can also be promoted to the title after the Indian Ocean.
·Tons of new content waiting for navigators to explore.

Malacca Overlord
·The overlord rules the Straits of Malacca. All ships traveling to and from the overlord need to pay taxes and surrender to the overlord. No one can escape!
·Defeat the overlord, you can take his place and rule Malacca!
·The Overlord can collect taxes from all captains entering and leaving the archipelago.

Treasure spot exploration
·Shipwreck reefs, beaches of doom, eye of storm... countless mysterious treasure spots scattered among the islands.
·However, ferocious pirates are entrenched among them. Can you take away the countless treasures?
·It is rumored that pirates occupy several ancient altars, and the secrets of the super powerful collection set [Great Dark Sky] are hidden in the altars. If you possess it, you will have the power to change the world!

 Mirror Sea Challenge
·There are legends about the challenge of the Sea of ​​Mirrors circulating in the archipelago. Strong men of all ages have obtained countless treasures and secrets from it, but more of them never came back.
·Completing different levels of Mirror Sea challenges will earn you rich rewards: limited skins, powerful collections, massive amounts of precious materials, etc.

Exotic goods exchange
·A strange goods exchange has appeared in Europe. Go to the East Indies to obtain strange goods, identify the trading opportunities, and earn super high profits!

Collection
·Added a new collection slot for ships of level 9 and above, allowing you to equip collections.
·The collection has rich basic attributes and even set effects.
·Collection attributes can be enhanced by suits, captains, skills, and skin effects.
·Collectibles can be obtained through archipelago treasure hunt points, mirror sea challenges, activities, etc.

Skin
·Optimized the presentation of skin
·Some skins have gained animation effects
·Added a variety of beautiful character skins and captain skins

Others
·Optimized the display effect of some interfaces
·The 6th Fantasy Challenge is ready to go
·The quantity of various goods has been increased. The higher the level of goods, the greater the increase.
